_about: Public-domain William Morley Punshon (1824-1881), Wesleyan Methodist preacher and lecturer, President of the Wesleyan Conference, for the Word Hoard: The Huguenots (1859), his Sermons (1860), Select Lectures and Sermons (1860), Life Thoughts (1863), Sabbath Chimes, meditations in verse (1867), The Prodigal Son (1868), Lectures and Sermons (1873), his collected Lectures (1882) and a second volume of Sermons edited by William Arthur (1882). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 75 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
